Perfect! After **f4+ Kh6 fxe5**, White wins the queen (9 points) for a knight (3 points)—a decisive +6 material advantage. This is clearly winning.

**Best move:** f4+

**Main line:** f4+ Kh6 fxe5 Kxh5 (Black captures the knight back, but White is up a queen for knight—huge advantage)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king is exposed and your opponent has a loose piece, look for checks that simultaneously attack another piece—that's a royal fork. Here f4+ checks the king on g5 while attacking the undefended queen on e5. After any king move, you capture the queen and win decisively. Always scan for forcing moves (checks and captures) first, especially when pieces are hanging.
